nrIncident.message:
A tunnel being closed for safety reasons at Farringdon means all lines are closed. As a result, trains between London St Pancras International and London Blackfriars will be cancelled or revised.
Major disruption is expected until 15:00.
A visual disruption map video is available.
Customer advice:
No trains can run between London St Pancras International and London Blackfriars until further notice. You will need to use an alternative route to reach your destination.
You should allow at least an additional 60 minutes to complete your journey today.
Please talk to station staff, look at the information boards or check your journey planner for the most recent information.
How is the service changing?
While this disruption is ongoing, these are the following changes to services:
North of London St Pancras International:
• Trains that normally run between Cambridge and London Kings Cross will run as booked
• Trains that normally run between and Brighton and Cambridge will terminate and restart at London Kings Cross
• Trains that normally run between Bedford and London St Pancras International will have a limited service running two trains per hour
• Trains that normally run between Luton and Sutton will now run between Luton and Kentish Town. This service will be reduced to two trains per hour
South of London Blackfriars:
• Trains that normally run between Horsham and Bedford will terminate and restart at London Blackfriars
• Trains that normally run between and Brighton and Bedford will terminate and restart at London Blackfriars. This service will be reduced to two trains per hour
• Trains that normally run between Sutton to Luton will now run between Sutton and London Blackfriars. This service will be reduced to two trains per hour
• Trains that normally run between Horsham and Peterborough will terminate and restart at East Croydon
Suspended services:
• Services running between Sutton and St Albans.
How do I get between London Blackfriars and London St Pancras International?
If you are travelling between these stations, you will need to use your ticket on London Underground or London Buses.
This is also the best way to get to City Thameslink and Farringdon.
Please be aware that this will take up to an additional 30 minutes.
Can I use my ticket with another operator North of London?
You can travel on the following services at no additional cost:
• Southern services between Horsham, Brighton, Sutton and London Victoria
• Great Northern services between London Kings Cross, Peterborough and Cambridge
